bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to transform and detoxify racist tweets into non-abusive text by analyzing the reduction of hateful n-grams, tracking transformation success rates, and comparing pre- and post-transformation semantic similarity.

Measuring the models' effectiveness in identifying and rephrasing religiously abusive text (e.g., anti-Muslim comments) using keyword searches, sentiment analysis (SenWave-BERT), and semantic similarity assessments.

Assessing how language models neutralize discriminatory text targeting specific nationalities or ethnic groups (e.g., Palestinian, Mexican) by evaluating the transformed text's sentiment distribution and measuring the retention of original context via cosine similarity.
